packageRules.description: Never edit pyproject.toml. Disable every dependency version update; uv.lock is refreshed wholesale by lockFileMaintenance, the equivalent of `uv lock -U` (latest versions allowed by the pyproject constraints).

Replaces the github-actions ecosystem previously handled by .github/dependabot.yml, which opened one PR per action. Every action is bumped in a single weekly PR instead. `minimumReleaseAge` is the supply-chain cooldown dependabot expressed as `cooldown.default-days`, and `pinDigests` keeps the `@<sha> # vX.Y.Z` form that zizmor's `unpinned-uses` audit requires.
